jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.jd_full:
What is saas.group?

The role is for a future CEO position at saas.group, tied to an upcoming acquisition in the HR tech and workforce management space. We are continuously acquiring new businesses and are building a strong talent pool of ambitious leaders who want to step into CEO roles within our portfolio. If you see yourself leading a SaaS business with us in the future, we'd love to connect.

At saas.group, we partner with ambitious leaders to transform great SaaS products into category leaders. Founded in 2017, we've built a global powerhouse of B2B SaaS companies by acquiring and scaling high-potential ventures. As a CEO within our group, you'll focus on what you do best — driving growth, building high-performing teams, and shaping product strategy — while we take the weight of administration, finance, and back-office complexity off your shoulders. With the backing of a fully remote team of 380+ colleagues across 50+ countries, you'll run your brand with the autonomy of a founder and the support of an experienced network that sets you up for long-term success.

We grow 23 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, and gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don't forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up to date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

We are looking for a CEO to lead one or more of our HR tech / workforce management SaaS brands into their next stage of growth and scale, with the potential to grow this into a multi-brand roll-up under one leader over time. As CEO, you will own the brand's P&L, strategy, growth, culture, and overall performance, driving both short-term execution and long-term strategic direction. You will work closely with our leadership team, board, and the broader saas.group community to deliver impact across go-to-market, product, operations, and finance. This role is an opportunity to shape the future of a small, highly profitable SaaS business (or cluster of businesses) within a high-growth portfolio, while having the backing, network, and resources of saas.group.

These are product-led, self-serve B2B SaaS businesses serving the German market first, with room to internationalize over time. We're looking for a strong product-led-growth operator and general manager: someone who can grow revenue and product and manage PnL.

Your responsibilities

  • Own growth for a product-led (PLG) SaaS business: sharpen the product, drive acquisition and activation, and build a scalable go-to-market engine: marketing and product are the two competencies that matter most here
  • Drive operational excellence: build budgets, track KPIs, optimize ROI, and implement process improvements that increase efficiency and scalability.
  • Build, coach, and retain a high-performing leadership team; create succession plans and ensure organizational resilience, including across multiple small, complementary brands as the portfolio grows.
  • Foster innovation by identifying disruptive trends (including AI), experimenting with new business models, and making data-driven bets that strengthen market position.
  • Champion a strong culture: set high performance standards, encourage collaboration, ensure alignment with saas.group values, and embed diversity and inclusion.
  • Be ready to take on additional brands within the same space as the portfolio grows

What you bring to the table

  • Proven leadership experience as a CEO, GM, or senior executive in a B2B SaaS HR Tech company, ideally product-led (PLG), with a strong track record of driving growth and building enduring businesses.
  • A strong operational and commercial background, first and foremost: you're an operator who has grown a product and a team
  • Marketing and product as core strengths: demonstrated ability to grow a SaaS product's user base and revenue through marketing-led and product-led motions.
  • Strong financial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, and P&L responsibility, with proven ability to link financial discipline to sustainable growth.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation through process improvements, operational standardization, and adoption of cutting-edge practices.
  • A talent magnet: skilled at hiring, developing, and retaining top performers, mentoring future leaders, and creating succession pipelines.
  • Strong people leadership: ability to set goals, hold teams accountable, address performance issues decisively, and nurture a culture of excellence.
  • Comfort managing more than one brand or business line at once, with the versatility to context-switch across a small portfolio of complementary products.
  • Fluent German speaker with strong English, given the initial market focus on Germany; international experience or ambition is a plus as these brands expand beyond DACH.
  • Visionary mindset with the ability to communicate a compelling long-term direction that inspires both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with fluency in English (additional languages are a plus).
  • AI Literacy & Application: You actively use AI tools to enhance personal productivity and work quality, staying curious about emerging capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply AI pragmatically in day-to-day work.

What's in it for you

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady and sustainable.
  • Small and friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning, and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd_full:
Our mission: e liminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We’re building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

Spring Health is actively seeking a VP, Global Strategy & Operations to join our team. This leader will drive our international operational strategy and partner closely with product, legal, and clinical teams to scale our international footprint. The VP, Global Strategy & Operations will cross-functionally orchestrate global delivery networks and optimize service reliability across the 200+ international markets in which we operate today. This is a full-time position that can be performed remotely, with quarterly travel to our New York City headquarters expected.

What you’ll do:

  • Orchestrate and align a highly cross-functional, matrixed team to deliver exceptional mental healthcare infrastructure to members, customers, and providers worldwide.
  • Influence and shape the long-term global expansion roadmap, largely focused on service delivery excellence and expansion versus country expansion, acting as an internal general manager to align organizational capabilities with market needs.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Go-To-Market teams to identify operational readiness capabilities that unblock and accelerate global revenue generation and market entry.
  • Build and instill deep operational rigor, systematic standardization, and process excellence across all international fulfillment and support channels.
  • Champion local market customization and regional delivery models to ensure care delivery is culturally relevant and clinically compliant with regional standards.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with regional providers and strategic fulfillment networks globally.
  • Balance complex international regulatory, legal, and operational trade-offs to keep cross-border service delivery moving forward quickly and safely.
  • Resolve high-friction cross-functional operational roadblocks and manage international dependencies under changing market conditions.
  • Audit and optimize regional operational processes to eliminate systemic inefficiencies and improve overall service velocity.

What success looks like in this role:

  • Meet or exceed established revenue expansion and retention goals.
  • Improve end-to-end operational efficiency metrics, reducing unit-level care support and fulfillment delivery costs while raising the bar on world-class quality standards.
  • Successfully execute and scale the in-house care delivery infrastructure roadmap to improve internal fulfillment capacity across core international target regions.

What you’ll bring:

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience heading complex operations, network management, or general management functions.
  • Direct experience successfully scaling operational footprints from the ground up from the United States into international markets.
  • Deep professional working knowledge of global healthcare delivery models, international compliance frameworks, and cross-border regulatory landscapes.
  • Proven track record managing and developing high-performing, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced matrixed environment.
  • Strong data-driven decision-making capability with demonstrated experience establishing operational tracking metrics and key performance indicators.
  • Excellent relationship-building capabilities with a pre-existing network of global healthcare stakeholders, providers, or vendors.

Nice to have:

  • Professional experience working within both employee benefits and commercial health plan operations spaces.
  • Experience designing or managing centralized global shared services models.

The target base salary range for this position is $230,400 - $290,000 and is part of a competitive total rewards package including equity and benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually using Radford Global Compensation Database at minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay.

Benefits provided by Spring Health:

Note: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria.

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medical accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.
  • Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning
  • A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents.
  • We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays.
  • At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non-birthing parents.
  • Access to Noom , a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals.
  • Access to fertility care support through Carrot, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses.
  • Access to Wellhub,  which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription
  • Access to BrightHorizons, which provides sponsored child care, back-up care, and elder care
  • Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year.
  • $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes.

Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Our privacy policy: https://springhealth.com/privacy-policy/

Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Program Manager III
jobs.jd_full:
Required Clearance: Secret

Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree

Required Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience

Position Description

PingWind is seeking a Program Manager III (PM) who will provide technical, analytical, and lifecycle support to the Maritime Electronic Warfare Systems Division (MEWSD) for critical U.S. Navy Electromagnetic Warfare (EW), Decoy, and Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program (SEWIP) systems. This role supports cradle-to-grave activities, including engineering, technology transition, installation, logistics, product support, test and evaluation, sustainment, maintenance, and repair. The PM III will integrate logistics, data science, reliability and maintainability engineering, and operations research to analyze and model complex systems, improve operational availability, and support data-driven decisions. This position directly contributes to optimizing warfighting capability, system readiness, reliability, and lifecycle performance while balancing mission requirements, performance, and cost.

Responsibilities:

Typical Responsibilities/Tasks:

•    Provide overall planning, direction, leadership, and oversight for major programs, systems development efforts, and research or technology initiatives.

•    Manage large, complex, multi-year programs consisting of multiple sub-programs, projects, and tasks.

•    Define the overall program structure, objectives, priorities, and organizational approach necessary to meet agency and mission requirements.

•    Develop and direct short- and long-range program plans to support successful program execution.

•    Formulate, guide, and direct the technical approach and overall program strategy.

•    Coordinate and negotiate with agency and activity personnel to identify and obtain the personnel, funding, equipment, and other resources required for program execution.

•    Establish and manage technical milestones, performance objectives, and program deliverables.

•    Develop, maintain, and control program schedules to ensure activities and milestones remain on track.

•    Establish, monitor, and control program budgets and costs throughout the program lifecycle.

•    Monitor overall program performance and take appropriate action to address schedule, cost, resource, or technical issues.

•    Coordinate activities across program teams and sub-programs to ensure efforts remain integrated and aligned with overall program objectives.

•    Maintain accountability for the overall success and execution of the program in support of organizational and agency requirements.

Required Qualifications

•   Minimum of 15 years of experience

About Pingwind

PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. We have extensive experience in the fields of cybersecurity, development, IT infrastructure, supply chain management and other professional services such as system design and continuous improvement. PingWind is a VA CVE certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and SBA HUBZone Certified with offices in Washington DC and Northern Virginia. www.PingWind.com

Our benefits include:

·       401k with competitive matching and vesting schedule

·       Continuing education assistance

·       Short Term / Long Term Disability & Life Insurance

·       Medical, Dependent Care and Commuter Flexible Spending Accounts

·       Employee Assistance Program

·       Wellness benefits include Calm Health app and WellHub gym subsidy (formerly GymPass)

jobs.title: Project Manager - AEC
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

CRB is a leading provider of sustainable Engineering, Architecture, Construction and Consulting solutions to the global life sciences and food and beverage industries. Our 1,200 employees provide best-in-class solutions that drive success and positive change for our clients, our people and our communities. CRB is a privately held company with a rich history of serving clients throughout the world, consistently striving for the highest standard of technical knowledge, creativity and execution.

Job Description

The Project Manager is responsible for the direction and performance of consulting, design or construction management services for assigned project(s) of a nature greater in scope, valuation and complexity and with larger teams than those generally managed by the Project Manager. Responsible for client relationship management, including creating a positive experience that will lead to future work. Projects often include several subcontracts and may include several aspects of an integrated ONEsolution delivery methodology.

Location: Kansas City, MO - Hybrid work mode, three days in office

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage multidisciplinary design projects, coordinating architectural and engineering teams through all phases of design delivery
  • Develop and manage project work plans, schedules, and budgets to support high-quality, on-time, and on-budget design execution
  • Serve as the primary client contact during the design phase, fostering trusted relationships and ensuring a positive client experience
  • Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across internal teams, consultants, and stakeholders
  • Monitor project progress, risks, and changes; proactively identify and address scope, schedule, or budget impacts
  • Ensure adherence to CRB’s design standards, quality procedures, and project controls
  • Support project staffing needs in coordination with discipline leaders
  • Track and report project performance metrics, including financials, schedule adherence, and client satisfaction
  • Contribute to business development efforts by supporting client relationships and identifying opportunities for follow-on work

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant project management experience, preferably within an architecture or engineering design firm
  • Demonstrated experience managing design projects or serving as a Project Manager or Assistant Project Manager on complex, multidisciplinary teams
  • Experience in Life Sciences, Food & Beverage, AEC, Pharma, Advanced Manufacturing, related field, preferred

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to lead and influence diverse design teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced design environment
  • Foundational understanding of architectural and engineering disciplines and the design project lifecycle
  • Professional certification (e.g., PMP, AECPM™) is preferred or willingness to obtain

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

CRB is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and it is our policy to provide equal opportunity to all people without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other legally protected category. Employment is contingent on background screening.

CRB does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or agencies. Any resume submitted to any employee of CRB without a prior written search agreement will be considered unsolicited and the property of CRB. Please, no phone calls or emails.

CRB offers a complete and competitive benefit package designed to meet individual and family needs.

If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact this employer to ask for an accommodation or an alternative application process.
